Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc
  • Class
    Description
    ColumnMeta
    Metadata for one column of a query result, captured from ResultSetMetaData so the grid can render and edit values without touching the (now closed) live result set.
    ConnectionProvider
    Opens, tests and closes JDBC Connections from a ConnectionProfile, independent of any particular database.
    ConnectionProvider.TestResult
    The outcome of a ConnectionProvider.test(org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.model.ConnectionProfile, org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.model.AppSettings) call.
    CsvExporter
    Exports a QueryResult to RFC 4180 CSV: a header row of column labels followed by the data rows, with fields quoted and internal quotes doubled only when they contain a comma, quote, CR or LF.
    DdlGenerator
    Generates a best-effort CREATE TABLE statement from JDBC column metadata, for the navigator's "view DDL" action.
    DmlBuilder
    Builds parameterized INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE statements from grid edits, so committing a data change never string-concatenates user values (which would risk both SQL injection and quoting bugs).
    DmlBuilder.PreparedSql
    A statement plus its ordered bind values.
    DmlBuilder.TableRef
    A table reference.
    MetadataReader
    Reads database structure (catalogs, schemas, tables, columns, keys) through the standard JDBC DatabaseMetaData API, so the navigator works against any driver without database-specific SQL.
    MetadataReader.ColumnInfo
    A column of a table.
    MetadataReader.ForeignKeyInfo
    A foreign-key relationship from a table to a parent table.
    MetadataReader.TableInfo
    A table or view.
    QueryExecutor
    Runs SQL against a live connection and captures the outcome into an immutable QueryResult, applying a fetch size, a query timeout and a hard row cap.
    QueryResult
    The outcome of executing one SQL statement: either a row set, an update count, or an error.
    SqlStatementSplitter
    Splits a SQL script into individual statements on semicolons, ignoring separators that appear inside string literals, quoted identifiers or comments.
